item.title: ‘Numpty’ who used forged notes at shops in Jersey sent to prison for 15 months
item.description: A 23-YEAR-OLD “numpty” who admitted several “unsophisticated” attempts to use forged banknotes at Island shops has been jailed for 15 months. Tyler Colin Ahier appeared before the Royal Court yesterday to be sentenced for seven charges of using notes which he knew to be forged. item.title: Cost of living remains the single biggest concern for Islanders
item.description: THE cost of living remains the single biggest concern for Islanders – cutting across age, income and household type – according to a major new survey.
